title: Recent Commit Depth Audit — What Was Built Deeply vs What Still Needs Carving
status: active population and depth programme under crystallized convergence
purpose: Audit the Sep 18 House/center expansion retrospectively for research depth, structural depth and population yield, then prioritize work that deepens many Rooms at once.
master_finding: The repository has crossed from architecture-first work into population and instrumentation. Ownership, topology, routing, center governance, Foundation genealogy and Below intelligence are now materially integrated; the highest remaining yield is longitudinal cases, measurable reproduction/exit/correction variables, Works instrumentation, real revision/repair runs and pruning of duplicate low-yield atlases.
audit_dimensions: implementation depth — is the concept actually wired into data/UI/governance?
source depth — are there multiple strong sources and historical layers?
structural consequence — did the research change the House or only add an example?
population yield — how many Rooms become easier to fill after this is deepened?

commit_waves.finding: One-owner custody, holdings and dossiers are strong. The remaining weakness was editorial fullness, not architecture.
commit_waves.action: Populate every dossier with center contribution, belongs/stays-out, tests and handoffs; this is being implemented in the synthesis branch.

commit_waves.finding: Heaven/World/Below and compass are useful projections, but comparative religion was used mainly to justify verticality. Axis-mundi scholarship adds a missing point: sacred centers are often replicated and multiple rather than one universal geometric center.
commit_waves.action: Add global-Axis vs local-axis/center distinction; allow Room-scale replicated centers without creating rival semantic centers.

commit_waves.finding: Project routing is detailed, but biological branching, root plasticity, liminal transition and formal recurrence were not deeply integrated.
commit_waves.action: Deepen Tree as regulated branching, Door as separation→liminality→incorporation, and Spiral as recurrence with measured state displacement.

commit_waves.finding: Many entities are correctly bounded and placed, but most entries are one-paragraph summaries rather than full tradition dossiers.
commit_waves.action: Do not deepen all entries. Select only structurally productive exemplars: Eden, Yggdrasil, Duat, Meru, Bardo, Gehenna/Hades/Sheol genealogy.

commit_waves.finding: Enough history was gathered to separate Great Seal facts from later esotericism, but the genealogy remains compressed: 1776 first-committee Eye, 1782 adopted reverse, unfinished pyramid, 13 levels, mottos, later dollar-bill reception, biblical Jachin/Boaz, and later Masonic pillar use deserve separate layers.
commit_waves.action: Build a dated genealogy rather than a single symbolic bundle.

commit_waves.finding: Terrain/regime classification is strong. Shadow remains underdeveloped as a crosscutting integration/visibility problem; analytical psychology explicitly includes positive as well as negative disowned capacities.
commit_waves.action: Separate shadow-content, shadow-process, projection and institutional/cultural shadow; keep Shadow crosscutting rather than Below-only.

commit_waves.finding: Center refocus is mature. Buddhism/Daoism/Akashic comparisons are intentionally bounded but still introductory.
commit_waves.action: Deepen only where the comparison sharpens a native operator: Wheel/Path→practice coordination; Daoist useful void→Door/House; yin-yang→nonmoral polarity; Akashic history→archive metaphor boundary.

commit_waves.finding: Organism/History are relatively grounded; Spirit and Culture remain the largest source-depth gaps.
commit_waves.action: Deepen Spirit across biblical breath-language, Stoic pneuma, systems spirituality and body-carrier boundaries; deepen Culture through norms, social identity, network transmission, institutions, coercive control and exit/correction mechanisms.

priority_queue.why: Door is used everywhere but has not yet been deeply carved as a transition grammar.
priority_queue.likely_structural_answer: A strong Door should have BEFORE state, SEPARATION condition, LIMINAL state, GUARD/TEST, AFTER state, and INCORPORATION/RETURN.
priority_queue.materialization_note: Added formal state-transition crosswalk, guard/controller observables, liminal dwell and recognition-gap metrics, plus rites-of-passage boundaries.

priority_queue.why: Spirit is central but externally sourced less deeply than Father/Son/biology/history.
priority_queue.likely_structural_answer: Spirit should be modeled as a family of relational functions with carriers, not as one substance or vague synonym for flow.
priority_queue.materialization_note: Added typed relation observables, Stoic pneuma and qi precision, and explicit carrier-vs-theology measurement boundaries.

priority_queue.why: Culture page is rich but the research model beneath formation→institution→capture is still thin.
priority_queue.likely_structural_answer: Culture should have state transitions from interaction→norm→identity→institution, with independent axes for cohesion, correction, authority concentration, dependency and exit cost.
priority_queue.materialization_note: Added multilevel norm observables, identity-conditioned influence, coercive-control scope limits, and concrete exit/correction variables.

priority_queue.why: Axis is globally defined but replicated centers inside houses, cities, bodies and Rooms have not been modeled.
priority_queue.likely_structural_answer: Keep one project semantic center and one global navigation Axis, but permit scoped local centers/axes as projections with explicit parent scope.
priority_queue.materialization_note: Search of current main shows scoped center levels, explicit semantic-global and spatial-global centers, parent-scope rules and validation in validate_house_governance.py; no duplicate research file added in this pass.

priority_queue.why: Fruit is the project's downstream test but remains more slogan than formal evaluation framework.
priority_queue.likely_structural_answer: Fruit should record output, beneficiary, timescale, observable effects, externalities, reversibility and whether new independent Seed/capacity is produced.
priority_queue.materialization_note: Added monitoring/contribution/attribution distinctions, counterfactual fields, OECD evaluation criteria crosswalk and anti-gaming review protocol.

priority_queue.why: Tree currently means differentiation but biological branching shows that branching is regulated, plastic and resource/environment dependent.
priority_queue.likely_structural_answer: Tree should expose branch initiation, suppression, resource cost, pruning, convergence and branch death—not only more branches.
priority_queue.materialization_note: Separated root-architecture plasticity from shoot-bud regulation and added branch economics, lifecycle metrics and pruning protocol.

priority_queue.why: Shadow is still visually associated with Below despite being declared crosscutting.
priority_queue.likely_structural_answer: Shadow becomes an occlusion/integration overlay with source, excluded content, projection target, cost and integration path.

priority_queue.why: The symbols are structurally useful but their historical layers remain easy to conflate.
priority_queue.likely_structural_answer: Treat Eye, Pyramid, 1776 and Twin Pillars as separate dated genealogies that meet only through typed reception/comparison edges.

priority_queue.why: Population waves are broad but each tradition is thin.
research_needed: one or two primary/academic sources per selected exemplar
priority_queue.likely_structural_answer: Promote only exemplars that teach a unique structural function; leave the rest room-detail/archive.

stop_rule: Do not add another broad comparative population wave until P0 operators have deeper source/context models and have been propagated into Room dossiers/public pages.
current_rule: Structural convergence through #283 remains crystallized. The 2026-09-18 operator-depth pass materially deepens Door, Spirit, Culture, Fruit and Tree in their canonical owners; scoped local centers were already implemented. Future work should propagate these stronger contracts into Room dossiers/readers and test them on real cases rather than create parallel atlases.
